title: Rajasthan Staff Selection Board RSSB Basic and Senior Computer Instructor Recruitment 2026 Answer Key
postName: Basic and Senior Computer Instructor - Advt. No. 07/2026
vacancyDetails: Basic Computer Instructor: 3629 posts. Senior Computer Instructor: 322 posts. Total: 3951 posts.
qualification: Senior Computer Instructor: Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and Communication Engineering or equivalent. Basic Computer Instructor: Bachelor's degree with A Level / PGDCA or relevant BE, B.Tech, B.Sc. Computer Science, IT or BCA qualification.
ageLimit: 18 to 40 years as on 01/01/2027. Relaxation as per RSSB rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC: 600/-. OBC NCL / SC / ST: 400/-. Correction charge: 300/-.
selectionProcess: Written examination → Answer key / objections → Document verification and final selection
documentsRequired: Admit card, registration details, answer key paper code, photo ID and supporting educational documents.
howToApply:
1. Open the appropriate Paper I or Paper II answer-key PDF.
2. Match your paper code with the answer key.
3. Check the RSSB notice for the objection process and deadline.
4. Keep a copy of the answer key and response details for reference.
shortDescription: RSSB Basic and Senior Computer Instructor Answer Key 2026 released on 18 September 2026 for the examination held on 22-23 August 2026. Download paper-wise answer keys.
content:
Rajasthan Staff Selection Board (RSSB / RSMSSB) has released the Basic and Senior Computer Instructor Answer Key 2026 for Advt. No. 07/2026.

The examination was conducted on 22-23 August 2026. Candidates can download the paper-wise answer keys for Basic Computer Instructor and Senior Computer Instructor and check the official notice for objections.

Important Dates

  • Application Begin: 25/05/2026
  • Last Date for Apply Online: 23/06/2026
  • Exam Date: 22-23 August 2026
  • Admit Card: 19/08/2026
  • Answer Key Available: 18/09/2026

  • Total: 3951 posts
